ai.seo_question: How did Imam Hasan and Imam Husayn resemble Prophet Musa physically?
ai.summary: This narration from Al-Kafi highlights the physical resemblance of Imam Hasan and Imam Husayn to Prophet Musa (AS), dividing the likeness at the navel to suggest a complementary unity in their prophetic heritage. Shia scholars often interpret this as reflecting their distinct spiritual and temporal roles, with Hasan embodying the aspect of patience and quiet authority (like Musa in Mecca) and Husayn embodying the aspect of active struggle and sacrifice (like Musa in Pharaoh's court). This physical description serves as a tangible sign of their status as inheritors of the prophetic light and authority.
